fields: h, intro, nav (the strip over the sheet), items [{t, d, key, link}], fold, fold_noun. key: the section's number and rule in flow. The fold applies on phones only (desktop shows the whole index).
best_for: IndexSheet shows a document package's index as one printed sheet: a limestone sheet on the navy band with the section title set very large, every section numbered in a ruled two-column grid with all its documents in view, and a folded leaf at the right carrying one isometric line drawing of the system the package comes with.
